description: Post-retrofit building performance dataset: Energy, IEQ, HVAC operation, and occupant behavior in university apartment buildings is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Sameeraa Soltanian-Zadeh et al. This paper presents a monitored dataset from single-family attached residences that underwent deep energy retrofits, complementing a previously published pre-retrofit dataset from the same buildings. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
